registryBasis: The official Spanish Directorate-General for Cadastre documents nationwide free cadastral cartography WMS and INSPIRE parcel services. The official Ayuntamiento de Santander portal separately names a municipal GIS viewer. This evidences relevant custodians/services, not a successful city parcel extraction.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Spain-wide cadastral cartography/INSPIRE services, with a Santander municipal GIS lead.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Public endpoint returned an HTML Catastro error page; no capabilities/schema response was obtained. TLS verification remained enabled.
HTTP retry of the documented INSPIRE endpoint also returned the same HTML error page; no parcel data was accepted as evidence.
Bounded anonymous GetFeatureInfo request around the exact WUP point after EPSG:25830 transformation returned HTML error content, not an ID/geometry response.
Official Santander municipal portal page loaded and names 'Visor Gis Municipal'; the route did not expose a directly usable anonymous parcel API in the inspected HTML.
Official city open-data catalog lead for a base-map dataset; metadata describes georeferenced base imagery, not cadastral parcel polygons.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identifier if publicly returned
remainingUncertainty: The exact point was not shifted and no zero-hit inference was made. Because the public endpoint returned HTTP 400 and the municipal GIS route was not API-resolved, citywide parcel coverage, current schema, CRS at the live route, and any Santander parcel native IDs remain unverified.
nextStep: Retry the documented public Catastro INSPIRE/WMS route when it returns a valid capabilities response, then request a small Santander bbox using only parcel ID and geometry. Separately inspect the municipal GIS viewer bootstrap if its public route becomes available.
